title: 英文晨读 20260730 US Humanoid Ban
content: title: 英文晨读_20260730_US_Humanoid_Bandate: 2026-07-30tags: [英文晨读, 科技新闻, 机器人, 贸易政策, 国家安全]series: 英文晨读封面信息 项目 内容 标题 US Bans Foreign-Made Humanoid Robots, Targeting China’s Dominance 来源 Associated Press (AP) / TechCrunch 作者 AP Staff / Zack Whittaker (TechCrunch) 发布时间 2026-07-29 (TechCrunch) / 2026-07-29 (AP) 原文链接 AP News / TechCrunch 预计阅读时长 约 15 分钟 题材分类 科技政策 / 机器人 / 国际贸易 全文摘要美国联邦通信委员会（FCC）于 7 月 29 日正式宣布禁止进口外国制造的新型人形机器人、四足机器狗和电力逆变器，理由是对美国国家安全构成”不可接受”的威胁。该禁令主要针对中国——中国在全球人形机器人市场占据约 85% 的份额，2025 年全球出货量约 1.5 万台，其中宇树科技（Unitree）和智元机器人（AGIBOT）各出货超 5000 台，远超特斯拉和 Figure AI 等美国同行。禁令还覆盖广泛应用于太阳能系统和数据中心的电力逆变器，但现有设备和已获批型号不受影响。北京迅速回击，外交部发言人毛宁指责华盛顿”过度泛化国家安全概念”以打压中国企业，并誓言采取”一切必要措施”维护中国企业合法权益。此举发生在习近平计划于 9 月访美与特朗普会晤之前，为本已紧张的中美关系增添了新的摩擦点。分析人士指出，禁令不大可能实质性减缓中国的人形机器人发展步伐，但可能干扰英伟达与宇树科技等现有的中美技术合作。 英文原文§1 The Trump administration has banned the import of new foreign-made humanoid robots, quadruped robot dogs, and power inverters, with the Federal Communications Commission citing an “unacceptable” threat to U.S. national security. The ban, announced on Tuesday, primarily targets China, which commands an estimated 85% of the global humanoid robot market. §2 The FCC said devices manufactured overseas could be remotely controlled or exploited for surveillance by foreign governments, or otherwise weaponized in cyberattacks against U.S. critical infrastructure. FCC Chairperson Brendan Carr described the move as necessary to “secure America’s critical supply chains,” emphasizing that the bans apply only to “new versions” of the covered imports. Exceptions may be granted if the government determines a specific device poses no national security risk. §3 Humanoid robots remain far from mainstream adoption, with approximately 15,000 units shipped globally in 2025. Yet China’s dominance is stark: Unitree and AGIBOT, two leading Chinese robotics firms, each shipped more than 5,000 units last year, while U.S. counterparts like Tesla and Figure AI shipped only a few hundred each, according to research firm Omdia. Morgan Stanley forecasts China’s humanoid market could reach $15 billion by 2030, with Chinese manufacturers scaling production and reducing costs faster than most overseas competitors. §4 The ban also covers power inverters — devices that convert direct current (DC) into alternating current (AC) and are widely used in solar energy systems, data centers, and household appliances. Analysts at Morningstar said the immediate impact on U.S. markets should be limited, as existing installations and previously approved models remain unaffected. However, the broader implications for the renewable energy supply chain could be significant given the concentration of inverter manufacturing overseas. §5 The restrictions come amid a broader U.S. campaign against Chinese technology. Previous FCC actions have targeted TikTok, Chinese-made consumer routers, drones, and surveillance equipment from Hikvision and Dahua. The latest ban also arrives ahead of a planned September state visit by Chinese President Xi Jinping to meet President Donald Trump in Washington, adding diplomatic tension to an already fraught relationship. “It’s a steady drumbeat of potential flashpoints heading into the Trump-Xi summit,” said Samm Sacks, a senior fellow at the New America think tank. §6 Beijing swiftly condemned the move. Foreign Ministry spokesperson Mao Ning accused Washington of “overstretching the concept of national security” to suppress Chinese firms, warning that “protectionism does not make the U.S. more competitive” and vowing to take “all measures necessary” to defend Chinese business interests. China’s Foreign Ministry added that the U.S. action would “only hurt the interests of U.S. companies and consumers.” §7 The ban could complicate existing U.S.-China tech collaborations. Nvidia recently unveiled a humanoid robot reference design built on Unitree’s chassis — a partnership that may now face regulatory hurdles. Morningstar analyst Kangyuxiao Li noted, however, that the restrictions are unlikely to materially slow China’s overall humanoid development, given the scale of its domestic manufacturing base and opportunities in other export markets. “Restricting their access to the U.S. removes an important future market and protects U.S. developers from potential price competition,” Li said. “However, it will not materially slow China’s overall humanoid development.” 生词释义表 序号 单词 词性 中文释义 原文例句 1 humanoid adj./n. 人形的；人形机器人 “banned the import of new foreign-made humanoid robots” 2 quadruped adj./n. 四足的；四足动物（此处指四足机器狗） “quadruped robot dogs” 3 inverter n. 逆变器（直流转交流的电力设备） “power inverters” 4 surveillance n. 监视，监控 “remotely controlled or exploited for surveillance” 5 cyberattack n. 网络攻击 “weaponized in cyberattacks against U.S. critical infrastructure” 6 stark adj. 鲜明的，赤裸裸的 “China’s dominance is stark” 7 counterpart n. 对应的人/物，同行 “U.S. counterparts like Tesla and Figure AI” 8 ramification n. （尤指复杂的）后果，影响 “could have sweeping ramifications” 9 drumbeat n. 连续而稳定的节奏；持续的鼓动 “a steady drumbeat of potential flashpoints” 10 flashpoint n. 爆发点，一触即发的局势 “potential flashpoints heading into the Trump-Xi summit” 11 condemn v. 谴责 “Beijing swiftly condemned the move” 12 overstretch v. 过度扩展/延伸；过度泛化 “overstretching the concept of national security” 13 protectionism n. 保护主义，贸易保护主义 “protectionism does not hurdles” 长难句解析句 1原句： The FCC said devices manufactured overseas could be remotely controlled or exploited for surveillance by foreign governments, or otherwise weaponized in cyberattacks against U.S. 表示，海外制造的设备可能被外国政府远程控制或用于监视，或在网络攻击中被武器化，以针对美国的关键基础设施。 语法知识点：过去分词作后置定语（manufactured overseas）；并列省略结构（后两个谓语省略 could be）；被动语态连续使用。 句 2原句： Yet China’s dominance is stark: Unitree and AGIBOT, two leading Chinese robotics firms, each shipped more than 5,000 units last year, while U.S. counterparts like Tesla and Figure AI shipped only a few hundred each, according to research firm Omdia. 结构拆解： 主句：China's dominance is stark 冒号后为解释说明句： 主语：Unitree and AGIBOT 同位语：two leading Chinese robotics firms 谓语：each shipped more than 5,000 units 时间状语：last year while 引导对比从句：U.S. counterparts ... shipped only a few hundred each 同位语：like Tesla and Figure AI 来源状语：according to research firm Omdia 中文翻译：然而中国的主导地位十分鲜明：据研究机构 Omdia 的数据，中国两家领先的机器人公司宇树科技和智元机器人去年各出货超过 5000 台，而特斯拉和 Figure AI 等美国同行各仅出货几百台。 Donald Trump in Washington, adding diplomatic tension to an already fraught relationship. 结构拆解： 主句：The latest ban also arrives 时间状语：ahead of a planned September state visit 修饰 visit：by Chinese President Xi Jinping 目的状语：to meet President Donald Trump in Washington 现在分词作结果状语：adding diplomatic tension to an already fraught relationship 中文翻译：此次最新禁令恰逢中国国家主席习近平计划于 9 unlikely to materially slow China’s overall humanoid development, given the scale of its domestic manufacturing base and opportunities in other export markets. 结构拆解： 主句：Morningstar analyst Kangyuxiao Li noted + that 宾语从句 插入语：however 宾语从句主语：the restrictions 谓语：are unlikely to materially slow 宾语：China's overall humanoid development given 引导原因状语：given the scale of ... and opportunities in ... 中文翻译：然而，Morningstar 分析师李康宇晓指出，考虑到中国国内制造业基地的规模以及其他出口市场的机遇，这些限制不太可能实质性地减缓中国人形机器人的整体发展。 语法知识点：插入语 however 的使用位置；be unlikely to 表否定推测；given 作介词引导原因（= considering）；materially 副词修饰 slow。 句 5原句： The ban title: 英文晨读 · 2026-08-02 · Google Earth AI Deepfake
content: 英文晨读 · 2026-08-02 · Google Earth AI Deepfake 封面信息 项目 内容 标题 Google Earth’s AI Deepfake Tool Only Lasted One Day 来源 The Verge 作者 Jay Peters Stevie Bonifield 发布时间 July 31, 2026 (Thursday) 原文链接 Article 1 / Article 2 预计阅读时长 约 15 分钟（含精读分析） 全文摘要Google 于本周四在 Google Earth 中上线了一项 AI 图像生成功能，允许用户通过文本提示编辑卫星图像。然而，安全研究员 Henk van Ess 随即演示了该功能可被用于制造逼真的虚假地理影像——包括在墨西哥边境添加难民、在加沙医院旁添加弹坑、在伊朗放置核设施。Google 最初回应称已内置 SynthID 数字水印并阻止有害主题，但仅一天后便紧急撤回了该功能，承认”人们截图分享了明显违反政策的生成图像”。此事件暴露了将 AI 图像生成嵌入高信任度地理信息平台的深层风险：即便有水印，用户仍可绕过检测工具传播虚假内容，而公众对 Google Earth 的信任可能被利用来放大错误信息。 英文原文[Paragraph 1] Google has shut down a Google Earth feature it launched Thursday that allowed users to edit satellite images with text prompts using AI. The tool essentially let users create AI deepfakes of the real world using text prompts; Digital Digging‘s Henk van Ess, for example, intentionally generated images adding things like refugees near the Mexican border, a bomb crater by a hospital in Gaza, and a nuclear plant in Iran. [Paragraph 2] On Thursday, Google’s initial response to van Ess noted that images generated with Nano Banana 2 in Google Earth included a digital watermark — specifically Google’s SynthID system — and that the company prevented “image creation on harmful topics.” Google also suggested users could verify suspicious images using the Gemini app or Lens in Search. [Paragraph 3] One day later, Google’s new statement took a sharply different tone: “We know that people uniquely trust Google Earth for a reliable view of the world. We’ve seen geospatial professionals using this feature for a range of useful purposes, however we’ve also seen people sharing screenshots of generated imagery that appear to violate our policies. So we’re rolling back this feature in Google Earth while we work on implementing stronger guardrails.” [Paragraph 4] The feature had launched globally on the web version of Google Earth earlier that week. Google’s blog post had originally pitched it as a tool for visualizing historical sites and real estate projects. Some AI-generated images were easy to spot as fakes — like one showing the Sphinx crossed with the Statue of Liberty — but others were believable enough to spread misinformation. [Paragraph 5] van Ess further demonstrated the limitations of Google’s safeguards. He was able to fool Hive’s AI detection tool with a video generated in Google Earth, showing how the generated media could spread despite the watermarks. In his testing, he reported that “nothing was refused, nothing was softened, and nothing suggested I try a different prompt.” While Google’s SynthID watermark may be difficult to remove, it is not impossible to miss or bypass. [Paragraph 6] The episode underscores a fundamental tension in consumer AI products: tools designed for creative or professional use can be rapidly weaponized for disinformation when embedded in platforms that carry high public trust. Google’s swift rollback suggests the company underestimated how quickly bad actors — or even well-intentioned researchers — would stress-test its content moderation systems in a geospatial context. Word count: ~415 生词释义表 单词 词性 中文释义 原文例句 deepfake n. 深度伪造（AI生成的虚假影像） The tool let users create AI deepfakes of the real world refugee n. 难民 adding refugees near the Mexican border crater n. 弹坑；陨石坑 a bomb crater by a hospital in Gaza watermark n./v. 数字水印；加水印 every image included the SynthID digital watermark screenshot n. 屏幕截图 people sharing screenshots of generated imagery guardrail n. 防护栏；安全护栏（引申为防护机制） implementing stronger guardrails visualize v. 可视化；使形象化 a tool for visualizing historical sites believable adj. 可信的；逼真的 believable enough to spread misinformation fool v. 欺骗；愚弄 he was able to fool Hive’s AI detection tool bypass v./n. 绕过；规避 not impossible to miss or bypass weaponize v. 武器化；将…用作武器 rapidly weaponized for disinformation underestimate v. 低估 the company underestimated how quickly geospatial adj. 地理空间的 in a geospatial context roll back phr.v. 撤回；回滚 rolling back this feature 长难句解析句 1原句：The tool essentially let users create AI deepfakes of the real world using text prompts; Digital Digging‘s Henk van Ess, for example, intentionally generated images adding things like refugees near the Mexican border, a bomb crater by a hospital in Gaza, and a nuclear plant in Iran. 结构拆解： 主句：The tool let users create AI deepfakes 状语（方式）：using text prompts 分号连接并列分句：Henk van Ess generated images 现在分词作后置定语：adding things like refugees…, a bomb crater…, and a nuclear plant… 中文翻译：该工具本质上允许用户通过文本提示创建真实世界的 AI 深度伪造影像；例如，Digital Digging 的 Henk van Ess 故意生成了在墨西哥边境添加难民、在加沙医院旁添加弹坑、以及在伊朗放置核设施等图像。 语法知识点：分号连接两个独立分句；现在分词短语 adding... 作伴随状语/后置定语修饰 images；三个并列名词短语作 like 的宾语。 句 2原句：We know that people uniquely trust Google Earth for a reliable view of the world. We’ve seen geospatial professionals using this feature for a range of useful purposes, however we’ve also seen people sharing screenshots of generated imagery that appear to violate our policies. 结构拆解： 句 1：We know that people trust Google Earth 状语：for a reliable view of the world 句 2（however 连接转折）：We‘ve seen professionals using this feature ~, however we‘ve seen people sharing screenshots 定语从句：that appear to violate our policies 修饰 generated imagery 中文翻译：我们知道人们独特地信任 Google Earth 能提供可靠的世界视图。我们见证了地理空间专业人士将这一功能用于多种有益目的，但我们也看到有人分享了明显违反我们政策而生成的图像截图。 语法知识点：that 引导宾语从句；see sb. doing sth. 结构（感官动词 + 宾语 + 现在分词）；however 作并列连词表转折；定语从句 that appear... 修饰先行词 generated imagery。 句 3原句：The episode underscores a fundamental tension in consumer AI products: tools designed for creative or professional use can be rapidly weaponized for disinformation when embedded in platforms that carry high public trust. 结构拆解： 主句：The episode underscores a fundamental tension 状语：in consumer AI products 冒号引出解释性同位语从句：tools can be weaponized 过去分词短语作定语：designed for creative or professional use 修饰 tools 时间状语从句：when (they are) embedded in platforms 定语从句：that carry high public trust 修饰 platforms 中文翻译：这一事件凸显了消费级 AI 产品中的一个根本性矛盾：那些为创意或专业用途而设计的工具，当被嵌入承载高度公众信任的平台时，可能迅速被武器化以用于制造虚假信息。 语法知识点：冒号引出同位解释；过去分词短语 designed for... 作后置定语；when embedded... 为省略了主语和 be 动词的时间状语从句（when they are embedded）；定语从句 that carry... 修饰 platforms。 句 4原句：Google’s swift rollback suggests the company underestimated how quickly bad actors — or even well-intentioned researchers — would stress-test its content moderation systems in a geospatial context. 结构拆解： 主句：Google's swift rollback suggests (that) … 宾语从句（省略 that）：the company underestimated … 嵌套宾语从句：how quickly bad actors would stress-test its systems 插入语（破折号）：or even well-intentioned researchers 状语：in a geospatial context 中文翻译：Google 的迅速撤回表明，该公司低估了恶意行为者——甚至善意的研究人员——在地理空间语境中对其内容审核系统进行压力测试的速度。 语法知识点：suggests 后省略 that 的宾语从句；how quickly 引导嵌套宾语从句，作 underestimated 的宾语；破折号插入补充说明；would stress-test 为过去将来时，与主句过去时 underestimated 保持时态一致。 背景知识补充 术语/人物 说明 Google Earth Google 旗下的虚拟地球软件，提供卫星图像、航拍和 3D 地形浏览，被广泛用于教育、科研和新闻报道中，具有高公信力。 Nano Banana 2 Google 推出的 AI 图像生成模型，此前已在 Google Earth 中被用于根据文本提示重新渲染卫星和航拍图像。 SynthID Google DeepMind 开发的数字水印技术，可在 AI 生成图像中嵌入肉眼不可见的标识，用于识别和验证图像真伪。 Henk van Ess 荷兰数字调查记者，运营 Digital Digging 博客，专注于开源情报（OSINT）和地理空间信息验证，以发现 AI 工具的安全漏洞知名。 Hive AI Detector Hive 公司开发的 AI 内容检测工具，用于识别图像/视频是否为 AI 生成，是业界常用的检测方案之一。 Sentinel-2 / Landsat 欧洲航天局（ESA）和美国 NASA 分别运营的地球观测卫星项目，提供公开可访问的真实卫星图像数据，可用于交叉验证。 晨读建议本材料建议按三步法练习，总时长约 15 分钟： 朗读（5 分钟）：大声朗读英文原文，注意生词的发音（尤其注意 geospatial /ˌdʒiːəʊˈspeɪʃəl/、weaponize /ˈwepənaɪz/）。段落 5 和 6 句式较复杂，可放慢速度，注重意群划分。 跟读（5 分钟）：遮住原文，播放自己朗读的录音（或用 TTS），逐句跟读模仿。重点关注长难句中的从句嵌套停顿，如句 3 中冒号后的同位解释部分需要停顿得当。 复述（5 分钟）：合上材料，用英语口头复述新闻要点。可参照以下提示词串联：Google Earth → AI image generation → deepfakes → researcher demonstrated → refugees / bomb crater / nuclear plant → SynthID watermark → fooled detection → rolled back in one day → trust vs. AI tools tension。目标是 1 分钟内完成流畅复述，不追求与原文完全一致。 来源声明 原文出处：The Verge — Google Earth’s AI deepfake tool only lasted one day / Here’s the problem with putting an AI image generator in Google Earth，作者 Jay Peters Stevie Bonifield，发布于 2026 年 7 月 31 日。 抓取时间：2026 年 8 月 2 日。 用途声明：本文仅用于个人英语学习，不构成对原文的替代。如需获取完整原始报道，请访问 The Verge 原文链接。（内容由AI生成，仅供参考）

content: 英文科技新闻晨读 · 15 分钟版封面信息 标题：SpaceX surges past $2 trillion in Nasdaq debut, closes in on Amazon 作者：Manya Saini, Echo Wang, Niket Nishant 媒体：Reuters（路透社） 发布时间：2026-08-05（约 6 小时前） 原文链接：https://sg.news.yahoo.com/finance/news/record-ipo-musks-spacex-faces-100248550.html 预计阅读时长：15 分钟 全文摘要SpaceX 于纳斯达克挂牌首日股价上涨 19%，收于每股 160.95 美元，市值突破 2.1 万亿美元，成为美国市值第六大公司，创始人埃隆·马斯克也因此成为全球首位净资产超过 1 万亿美元的富豪。此次 IPO 以 750 亿美元募资规模刷新历史纪录，是 2019 年沙特阿美 IPO 募资额的两倍多。尽管 SpaceX 目前尚未盈利，散户投资者仍获得约 20% 的配售比例，远超一般 IPO，首日成交量与成交额均极为可观。分析师普遍提醒投资者注意其高估值与流通盘偏小带来的波动风险，并预计其快速纳入纳斯达克 100 指数将带来新的被动资金买盘。 英文原文SpaceX surges past $2 trillion in Nasdaq debut, closes in on Amazon[1] SpaceX shares jumped 19% in their Nasdaq debut on Friday, sending the company’s value past $2 trillion to make it the sixth-biggest U.S. company by value and turning Elon Musk into the world’s first trillionaire. [2] Investors jumped at the chance to get a piece of Musk’s sprawling empire spanning rockets, satellites and AI after the record-setting $75 billion IPO. More than 510 million shares worth about $84 billion changed hands, even though SpaceX is currently unprofitable and generated only a fraction of the revenue brought in by similarly valued tech giants. [3] The launch was smoother than many observers expected, with trading kicking off late on Friday morning without the hiccups that had marred Facebook’s debut in 2012. [4] SpaceX shares ended the day at $160.95 a share to bring its value to $2.1 trillion. The gain pushed SpaceX’s market value past Broadcom, with Amazon next in line at $2.6 trillion. [5] The trade capped off a lead-up fraught with anxiety over the Nasdaq exchange’s ability to handle the launch, particularly after a recent swoon in technology shares raised concerns about stratospheric gains in AI-linked names. [6] Mega-listings from AI heavyweights Anthropic and OpenAI are waiting in the wings. [7] Investors across the spectrum, from large institutions to retail fans of Musk, ended the day euphoric. [8] “For many investors, SpaceX is the closest thing to investing in the railroads during the Industrial Revolution and they are willing to pay the Elon Musk premium for that opportunity,” said Seth Hickle, chief investment officer at Mindset Wealth Management in Indianapolis. [9] Analysts and portfolio managers said investors should brace for volatility, particularly early in SpaceX’s life as a public company, due to its small relative float and high valuation. [10] SpaceX’s $18.7 billion in revenue gives the company a price-to-revenue ratio of roughly 112, far above other megacap stocks. [11] “The question remains is, what happens in a couple of weeks from now. Right now, people want to bid the stock higher because it’s a winner at this point. Whether it stays that way, that remains to be seen,” said Todd Schoenberger, chief investment officer at Crosscheck Management in Washington, D.C. [12] Retail investors received about 20% of the allocation, far more than the typical IPO, with some even celebrating an allocation of one share. [13] SpaceX executives, including President Gwynne Shotwell and Chief Financial Officer Bret Johnsen, celebrated at the Nasdaq market site in New York’s Times Square after ringing the opening bell on Friday. Musk held a separate event for employees in Texas. [14] The IPO is a culmination of Musk’s long-held ambitions in space and technology, and has stood out for rewriting Wall Street’s IPO playbook and drawing legions of retail investors into the market. [15] “Elon deserves an extreme premium because of his track record and his vision for calling technology trends early,” said Shaun Maguire, a Sequoia Capital partner who has led the firm’s $2 billion investment in SpaceX. Sequoia Capital’s investment is worth over $20 billion at the IPO price, a person familiar with the matter told Reuters. [16] At $75 billion, the IPO’s proceeds were more than double those of Saudi Aramco’s record-setting 2019 IPO. [17] SpaceX’s valuation could rise further should underwriters exercise their right to sell additional shares, a decision typically made within 30 days after the offering. [18] “Seeing the company that I joined when it was just some sketches on paper become this valuable is almost surreal,” said Tom Mueller, a founding SpaceX employee who spent 18 years at the company and a shareholder, who is now CEO of Impulse Space, a spacecraft startup. [19] An estimated 4,000 current or former SpaceX employees will become millionaires based on the value of their SpaceX shares, according to Hill.com. [20] Although SpaceX’s lack of profitability makes it ineligible to join the SP 500, its expected fast-track inclusion in the Nasdaq 100 will soon make it a major holding for passive funds and ETFs that track the index, creating a fresh source of demand for its shares. 生词释义表 单词 词性 中文释义 原文例句 debut n. 首次亮相；首次公开上市 SpaceX shares jumped 19% in their Nasdaq debut on Friday. sprawling adj. 广阔绵延的，庞大铺开的 a piece of Musk’s sprawling empire spanning rockets, satellites and AI unprofitable adj. 不盈利的，无利润的 even though SpaceX is currently unprofitable hiccup n. 小问题，小故障 without the hiccups that had marred Facebook’s debut in 2012 mar v. 破坏，损毁 the hiccups that had marred Facebook’s debut fraught adj. 充满（艰难、危险）的 a lead-up fraught with anxiety swoon n. （股价等的）暴跌 after a recent swoon in technology shares stratospheric adj. 极高的；平流层的 stratospheric gains in AI-linked names euphoric adj. 极度兴奋的，狂喜的 ended the day euphoric brace v. 做好准备（应对困难） investors should brace for volatility volatility n. 波动性，不稳定性 investors should brace for volatility float n. 流通股数量 due to its small relative float megacap adj./n. 超大型市值的（公司） far above other megacap stocks allocation n. 配售；分配额 Retail investors received about 20% of the allocation culmination n. 顶点，高潮 The IPO is a culmination of Musk’s long-held ambitions 长难句解析句子 1原句：Investors jumped at the chance to get a piece of Musk’s sprawling empire spanning rockets, satellites and AI after the record-setting $75 billion IPO. 结构拆解： [主句] Investors jumped at the chance[后置定语] to get a piece of Musk's sprawling empire[分词定语] spanning rockets, satellites and AI ← 修饰 empire[时间状语] after the record-setting $75 billion IPO 中文翻译：在创纪录的 750 亿美元 IPO 之后，投资者争相抓住机会，入股马斯克横跨火箭、卫星和人工智能的庞大商业帝国。 语法知识点：现在分词短语（spanning…）作后置定语修饰名词；不定式（to get…）作后置定语修饰 chance；jump at the chance 为固定搭配，意为”抓住机会”。 句子 2原句：The trade capped off a lead-up fraught with anxiety over the Nasdaq exchange’s ability to handle the launch, particularly after a recent swoon in technology shares raised concerns about stratospheric gains in AI-linked names. 结构拆解： [主句] The trade capped off a lead-up[过去分词短语] fraught with anxiety ← 修饰 lead-up[介词短语] over the Nasdaq exchange's ability to handle the launch[时间状语从句] particularly after a recent swoon ... raised concerns about ... 中文翻译：这场交易为一段充满焦虑的筹备期画上了句号——此前人们一直担心纳斯达克交易所能否承受这次上市，尤其是近期科技股暴跌引发了人们对 AI 相关股票超高涨幅的担忧。 语法知识点：过去分词短语（fraught with anxiety）作后置定语；副词 particularly 引导的状语从句中，从句谓语 raised 是过去时，与主句时态呼应；be fraught with 为固定搭配，意为”充满……的”。 句子 3原句：Seeing the company that I joined when it was just some sketches on paper become this valuable is almost surreal, said Tom Mueller, a founding SpaceX employee who spent 18 years at the company and a shareholder, who is now CEO of Impulse Space, a spacecraft startup. 结构拆解： [主语] Seeing the company ... become this valuable ← 动名词短语[定语从句] that I joined[时间状语从句] when it was just some sketches on paper[系表] is almost surreal[倒装引语] said Tom Mueller[同位语] a founding SpaceX employee ... and a shareholder[定语从句] who spent 18 years at the company / who is now CEO of Impulse Space[同位语] a spacecraft startup 中文翻译：”看到我加入时还只是纸上草图的公司变得如此值钱，几乎有点不真实。”SpaceX 创始员工、在公司工作了 18 年且目前仍是股东的汤姆·穆勒说。他现在是航天器初创公司 Impulse Space 的 CEO。 语法知识点：动名词短语作主语，内部嵌套 that 引导的定语从句和 when 引导的时间状语从句；said Tom Mueller 为引用倒装结构；连续使用同位语和定语从句展开人物身份，是新闻英语的典型写法。 句子 4原句：Although SpaceX’s lack of profitability makes it ineligible to join the SP 500, its expected fast-track inclusion in the Nasdaq 100 will soon make it a major holding for passive funds and ETFs that track the index, creating a fresh source of demand for its shares. 结构拆解： [让步状语从句] Although SpaceX's lack of profitability makes it ineligible to join the SP 500[主句] its expected fast-track inclusion ... will soon make it a major holding[定语从句] that track the index ← 修饰 passive funds and ETFs[结果状语] creating a fresh source of demand for its shares 中文翻译：尽管 SpaceX 因尚未盈利而无缘纳入标普 500 指数，但它预计将被快速纳入纳斯达克 100 指数，很快成为跟踪该指数的被动基金和 ETF 的重仓股，从而为其股票带来新的需求来源。 语法知识点：make + 宾语 + 形容词/名词的复合宾语结构出现两次（make it ineligible / make it a holding）；现在分词短语（creating…）作结果状语；fast-track 为复合形容词，意为”快速通道的”。 背景知识补充 SpaceX：埃隆·马斯克 2002 年创立的太空探索技术公司，核心业务为火箭发射、星链（Starlink）卫星互联网和人工智能（xAI）。 纳斯达克（Nasdaq）：美国电子证券交易所，是科技股上市的主要场所，SpaceX 股票代码为 SPCX。 IPO（首次公开募股）：公司首次向公众投资者发售股票，实现公开上市的过程。 埃隆·马斯克（Elon Musk）：SpaceX 创始人兼 CEO，同时执掌特斯拉，因 SpaceX 上市成为全球首位净资产超 1 万亿美元的富豪。 Gwynne Shotwell（格温·肖特韦尔）：SpaceX 总裁兼首席运营官，负责公司日常运营。 标普 500 / 纳斯达克 100 指数：分别由美国 500 家大型公司和纳斯达克 100 家最大非金融公司组成的股票指数，被大量被动基金跟踪。 承销商（underwriters）：负责协助公司发行股票的投资银行（如高盛、摩根士丹利），可在上市后 30 天内行使超额配售权（绿鞋机制）。 散户投资者（retail investors）：个人投资者，与机构投资者相对；本次 IPO 散户获配约 20%，远超一般大型 IPO 的不到 10%。 红杉资本（Sequoia Capital）：全球知名风险投资机构，对 SpaceX 投资 20 亿美元，IPO 后持仓价值超 200 亿美元。 沙特阿美（Saudi Aramco）：沙特国有石油公司，2019 年 IPO 募资约 294 亿美元，此前为全球最大 IPO，现被 SpaceX 超越。 市销率（price-to-revenue ratio）：市值与营收之比，SpaceX 约 112 倍，远高于其他大型科技股，反映市场对其增长的高度预期。 晨读建议第一步：朗读通读英文原文 2～3 遍，重点关注加粗词汇所在的句子，注意数字（$2 trillion、$160.95、19%、20%）与机构名称的准确读法，保持自然语速与句子重音。 第二步：跟读对照生词表校准 15 title: 英文晨读 20260818：宇树科技创纪录 IPO，人形机器人登陆科创板
content: 英文晨读 20260818：宇树科技创纪录 IPO，人形机器人登陆科创板一、封面信息 标题：Chinese Humanoid Robot Maker Unitree to List in Shanghai on August 19 媒体：Reuters（路透社，主文）；MarketInsiders / eSIM.Report（补充段落） 发布时间：2026-08-17（北京时间 8 月 17 日晚间） 原文链接：Reuters 转载（MarketScreener） ｜ MarketInsiders 补充报道 预计阅读时长：约 15 分钟（原文 4–5 分钟 + 精读 10 分钟） 二、全文摘要中国最受瞩目的人形机器人制造商宇树科技（Unitree）将于 8 月 19 日在上海证券交易所科创板上市，成为 A 股首家通用机器人上市公司。公司发行价 150.80 元/股，募资约 61 亿元人民币，IPO 获散户超额认购逾 8000 倍，创科创板历史纪录。宇树以四足机器狗起家，后成为全球人形机器人销量第一的企业，其机器人因奔跑、跳舞、打武术等能力受到全球关注。此次上市被视为”物理 AI”（具身智能）赛道从风险投资故事走向公开市场检验的标志性事件，也是投资者对整个人形机器人产业信心的一次公开测试。 三、英文原文Paragraph 1（Reuters 原文） BEIJING, Aug 17 (Reuters) — China’s most high-profile humanoid robot maker Unitree will make its stock market debut in Shanghai on August 19, a filing to the bourse showed on Monday. The company is the world’s biggest humanoid-robot maker by sales and the first general-purpose robotics company to debut in mainland China. Its humanoid robots have drawn global attention for their running, dancing and performing of martial arts, and the IPO was more than 8,000 times oversubscribed by retail investors, a record for Shanghai’s STAR Market for tech startups. Paragraph 2 Unitree, formally Yushu Technology, will issue 40.45 million new shares at 150.80 yuan ($22.35) each, equal to 10 percent of its post-IPO share capital, raising about 6.1 billion yuan ($904 million) and valuing the company at about 61 billion yuan. Newly listed shares on the STAR Market are exempt from price limits during the first five trading days, which could increase volatility. The company develops, manufactures and sells bipedal humanoid robots, quadruped robot dogs, robotic components and embodied-intelligence models. Paragraph 3 The retail part of the offer was more than 8,000 times oversubscribed, meaning the number of shares sought by small investors was more than 8,000 times the number of shares set aside for them. This is not just a strong result for Unitree; it is a record for the STAR Market, a board that focuses on technology companies and new businesses. Such a high level of demand shows that many investors see humanoid robots as a major future technology. The level of demand is especially notable because Unitree is entering a sector that still has many questions around its long-term size and profits. Investors appear ready to accept those risks in the hope that humanoid robots can become a major part of the technology industry. Paragraph 4 Unitree has attracted international attention with humanoid and quadruped robots capable of running, dancing, navigating environments, and performing complex movements. The listing comes as AI investment increasingly shifts from software to “physical AI,” where machine-learning systems control robots operating in factories, warehouses, homes, and public environments. China has made robotics a strategic industrial priority and benefits from an enormous domestic manufacturing supply chain that could help lower hardware costs faster than Western rivals. The IPO will provide an unusually public test of investor appetite for humanoid robotics as an operating business rather than a private venture-capital story. Paragraph 5 Humanoid robots have become one of the most watched areas of the technology industry, and China has become a major center for robotics research and production. The market is still young, however: companies must prove that humanoid robots can move from demonstrations and research use to large-scale commercial use. Unitree’s debut will therefore be more than a normal IPO. It will serve as a major test of investor confidence in humanoid robots and China’s technology sector. With the debut set for August 19, all eyes are now on Unitree and its first day on the Shanghai Stock Exchange. 四、生词释义表 单词 词性 中文释义 原文例句 high-profile adj. 高调的；备受瞩目的 China’s most high-profile humanoid robot maker Unitree will make its stock market debut in Shanghai. debut n./v. 首次亮相；（公司）首次上市 Unitree will make its stock market debut in Shanghai on August 19. bourse n. （尤指欧洲的）证券交易所 a filing to the bourse showed on Monday oversubscribed adj. （股票发行）超额认购的 the IPO was more than 8,000 times oversubscribed by retail investors volatility n. 波动性；易变性 Newly listed shares are exempt from price limits, which could increase volatility. bipedal adj. 双足的；两足行走的 The company develops, manufactures and sells bipedal humanoid robots. quadruped adj./n. 四足的；四足动物 quadruped robot dogs embodied-intelligence n. 具身智能（AI 与物理实体的结合） embodied-intelligence models set aside 动词短语 拨出；留出 the number of shares set aside for them strategic adj. 战略性的；关键的 China has made robotics a strategic industrial priority. supply chain n. 供应链 an enormous domestic manufacturing supply chain appetite n. 兴趣；意愿；胃口 an unusually public test of investor appetite for humanoid robotics venture-capital n. 风险投资 a private venture-capital story large-scale adj. 大规模的 move to large-scale commercial use 五、长难句解析1. Its humanoid robots have drawn global attention for their running, dancing and performing of martial arts, and the IPO was more than 8,000 times oversubscribed by retail investors, a record for Shanghai’s STAR Market for tech startups. 结构拆解：并列复合句 = 主句 1（Its humanoid robots have drawn global attention for …）+ and + 主句 2（the IPO was more than 8,000 times oversubscribed by retail investors）+ 同位语（a record for Shanghai’s STAR Market …，补充说明整个超额认购事实） 中文翻译：其人形机器人因其奔跑、跳舞和武术表演而引发全球关注，此次 IPO 获散户投资者超额认购逾 8000 倍，创下上海科创板科技初创企业的纪录。 语法知识点：被动语态（was oversubscribed）；倍数表达（more than 8,000 times）；名词短语作同位语补充说明整个句子。 2. The level of demand is especially notable because Unitree is entering a sector that still has many questions around its long-term size and profits. 结构拆解：主句（The level of demand is especially notable）+ 原因状语从句（because Unitree is entering a sector）+ 定语从句（that still has many questions …，修饰 sector） 中文翻译：这一需求水平尤其引人注目，因为宇树正进入一个在长期规模与盈利方面仍存在诸多疑问的行业。 语法知识点：because 引导原因状语从句；that 引导定语从句并在从句中作主语；介词短语 around … 作后置定语。 3. The listing comes as AI investment increasingly shifts from software to “physical AI,” where machine-learning systems control robots operating in factories, warehouses, homes, and public environments. 结构拆解：主句（The listing comes）+ as 时间/伴随状语从句（AI investment increasingly shifts from software to “physical AI”）+ where 非限制性定语从句（where machine-learning systems control robots operating in …，修饰 physical AI）+ 分词短语（operating in …，作 robots 的后置定语） 中文翻译：此次上市恰逢 AI 投资日益从软件转向”物理 AI”——即机器学习系统控制着在工厂、仓库、家庭和公共环境中作业的机器人。 语法知识点：as 引导时间状语从句表示”随着”；where 引导非限制性定语从句；现在分词短语 operating in … 作后置定语，表主动与进行。 4. The IPO will provide an unusually public test of investor appetite for humanoid robotics as an operating business rather than a private venture-capital story. 结构拆解：主句（The IPO will provide an unusually public test）+ 介词短语后置定语（of investor appetite for humanoid robotics）+ 对比结构（as an operating business rather than a private venture-capital story） 中文翻译：此次 IPO 将提供一个异常公开的检验机会，检验投资者对”作为一项运营业务、而非私人风投故事”的人形机器人行业的真实兴趣。 语法知识点：rather than 连接两个对等成分表对比；as 引出身份/定位；长介词链作后置定语是新闻英语的典型特征。 六、背景知识补充 Unitree（宇树科技）：2016 年创立于杭州，创始人王兴兴，以四足机器狗起家，后推出双足人形机器人，2025 年人形机器人出货量超 5500 台、全球第一。 STAR Market（科创板）：上交所 2019 年设立的科技型板块，允许未盈利科技企业上市，新股上市前 5 个交易日不设涨跌幅限制。 Physical AI / 具身智能：指 AI 模型不再局限于屏幕内，而是与机器人等物理实体结合，能感知、决策并执行动作，被视为 AI 投资的下一阶段。 战略配售：宇树上市引入 DeepSeek、腾讯旗下启善投资等产业资本作为战略投资者，意在推进 AI 大模型与具身智能的协同。 Tesla Optimus（特斯拉擎天柱）：特斯拉的人形机器人产品线，被宇树在招股书中明确列为潜在竞争对手，人形机器人赛道的中美竞争由此展开。 七、晨读建议（朗读 → 跟读 → 复述三步法） 朗读（约 5 分钟）：通读英文原文 1–2 遍，先解决生词发音（尤其 oversubscribed、bourse、quadruped、volatility），注意第 1 段和第 4 段的长句停顿与节奏。 跟读（约 5 分钟）：回放新闻音频（可借助 Reuters/TechCrunch 同类播报）或录音对比，模仿新闻主播在逗号、同位语前的自然断句，重点跟读加粗关键词所在句子，训练语流。 复述（约 5 分钟）：合上材料，用 3–5 句英文复述核心事实（上市时间、发行价、募资规模、认购倍数、战略意义），再用背景知识部分做中文对照自查，检验理解是否完整。 八、来源声明 主文：Reuters 报道《Chinese humanoid robot maker Unitree to list in Shanghai on August 19》，2026-08-17 发布，记者 Shi Bu、Yukun Zhang、Eduardo Baptista，编辑 Kirsten Donovan；正文经 MarketScreener（hk.marketscreener.com）转载获取。 补充段落：MarketInsiders《Unitree IPO Draws Record Demand Ahead of Shanghai Debut》（2026-08-17）；eSIM.Report《Unitree to list on Shanghai STAR Market on 19 August》（2026-08-17）；TechStartups《Top Tech News Today, August 17, 2026》（2026-08-17）。 抓取时间：2026-08-18 11:30（北京时间）。 声明：本材料仅用于个人英语学习，非投资建议；数据以原文发布时点为准。（内容由AI生成，仅供参考）

title: 英文晨读_20260819_ChatGPT_Teens
content: 英文晨读_20260819_ChatGPT_Teens 封面信息 标题：OpenAI makes ChatGPT less ‘human’ for teens in new safety update 作者：Zoe Kleinman（Technology and AI editor） 媒体：BBC News（Technology） 发布时间：2026-08-18 11:26 UTC（约 16 小时前） 原文链接：https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/czxqz91n5n8o 预计阅读时长：约 45 分钟（正文约 570 词，按 120150 wpm 计） 全文摘要 OpenAI 于 8 月 18 日推出面向 18 岁以下用户的 “ChatGPT for Teens” 青少年版本，新增一系列安全功能，包括可关闭人声回复、定期休息提醒、学习模式与”安静时段”。 公司强调这些变化并非针对具体事件，但外界对用户把 AI 工具当作有感知能力的”活物”的担忧日益加剧；微软 AI 主管穆斯塔法·苏莱曼也曾表示，”看似有意识”的 AI 产品让他夜不能寐。 青少年账号将默认开启保护设置，未满 13 岁禁止使用；OpenAI 计划把进食障碍相关提示加入需通报家长的警示清单，每条警报发出前都会经过人工审核。 文章补充指出，英国目前尚无针对 AI 的专门监管；智库报告显示多数英国大学面临学生利用 AI 提升成绩的风险；医学专家警告”超加工信息”可能造就”超加工思维”。 英文原文Paragraph 1 The maker of ChatGPT is rolling out a range of new safety features today for under-18s who use the AI chatbot. Paragraph 2 Those with new teen accounts will be able to switch off the human voice response, in order to minimise the tech’s ability to appear like a person. Paragraph 3 OpenAI is also introducing regular reminders for young people to take a break from using the tool, reminding them ChatGPT is AI, and saying “it can wait”. Paragraph 4 The firm insisted this was not in response to a particular issue with children believing ChatGPT to be alive - but there are growing concerns about people becoming convinced that the AI tools they interact with are sentient. Paragraph 5 Last year Mustafa Suleyman, the head of AI at rival firm Microsoft, said “seemingly conscious“ AI products “kept him awake at night” because he was so worried about their impact on society. Paragraph 6 In other areas, OpenAI seems to be loosely following the teen account model developed by the large social networks. Paragraph 7 In a blog post announcing ChatGPT for Teens, the firm said teenagers’ use of AI “should come with protections that reflect their developmental stage, reinforce real-world relationships, and support healthy use over time”. Paragraph 8 It said teen accounts would become the default for those who identified themselves as teenagers when they signed up, and others whom the firm itself identified as under 18. Paragraph 9 But it did not elaborate on how it would identify these teens. Paragraph 10 Under-13s are not allowed to use the product. Paragraph 11 (Study Mode and quiet time) Last year, ChatGPT launched Study Mode for students, in which it talks through schoolwork without giving away the answers. Paragraph 12 Young people will now be able to set Study Mode hours during which this will be the default setting. Paragraph 13 They will also be able to activate “quiet times” when the tool will be switched off for them. Paragraph 14 OpenAI says of the young people who use ChatGPT, nine out of 10 use it to help them with learning. Paragraph 15 A report released yesterday by the Policy Exchange think tank claimed that the majority of UK universities are leaving themselves exposed to students enhancing their grades using AI by relying on online exams completed remotely. Paragraph 16 It said 94% of the students it spoke to admitted to using the tech in assessments. Paragraph 17 OpenAI is also adding eating disorder-themed prompts to a list of harmful user requests which will be flagged to parents with linked accounts. Paragraph 18 The company said each alert would be reviewed by a human before it was sent, and it aimed to have them with parents within an hour of the request being made. Paragraph 19 In its blog, OpenAI said it would focus on “moments when offline support may matter most”. Paragraph 20 So far, there is no bespoke AI regulation in the UK. The government under former prime minister Sir Keir Starmer considered restricting AI chatbots for under-18s alongside its other reforms on social media use by children. Paragraph 21 Anthropic’s AI tool Claude is still for adults only. When Google first launched its Gemini AI tool, initially called Bard, it also did not allow children to use it. Paragraph 22 Dr Susan Shelmerdine, a medical imaging doctor at Great Ormond Street Hospital and an AI academic, told the BBC last year that one day doctors may start asking patients how much they use AI, in the same way that they currently ask about smoking and drinking habits. Paragraph 23 “We already know what ultra-processed foods can do to the body and this is ultra-processed information. We’re going to get an avalanche of ultra-processed minds,” she said. 生词释义表 单词 词性 中文释义 原文例句 roll out v. 短语 推出；推广 The maker of ChatGPT is rolling out a range of new safety features today for under-18s. minimise v. 使降到最低限度；使减到最少 …in order to minimise the tech’s ability to appear like a person. convinced adj. 深信不疑的；确信的 …there are growing concerns about people becoming convinced that the AI tools they interact with are sentient. sentient adj. 有感知能力的；有知觉的 …growing concerns about people becoming convinced that the AI tools they interact with are sentient. conscious adj. 有意识的；清醒的 “seemingly conscious” AI products “kept him awake at night”. developmental adj. 发育的；发展的 …protections that reflect their developmental stage… reinforce v. 加强；巩固 …reinforce real-world relationships, and support healthy use over time. default n. / adj. 默认设置（的） Teen accounts would become the default for those who identified themselves as teenagers. elaborate v. 详细说明；详尽阐述 But it did not elaborate on how it would identify these teens. exposed adj. 暴露的；面临风险的 …UK universities are leaving themselves exposed to students enhancing their grades using AI… remotely adv. 远程地 …online exams completed remotely. flagged v.（过去分词） 标记；警示 …harmful user requests which will be flagged to parents with linked accounts. bespoke adj. 定制的；专门针对的 So far, there is no bespoke AI regulation in the UK. ultra-processed adj. 超加工的；深度加工的 …this is ultra-processed information. avalanche n. 雪崩；大量涌现的事物 We’re going to get an avalanche of ultra-processed minds. 长难句解析1. The firm insisted this was not in response to a particular issue with children believing ChatGPT to be alive - but there are growing concerns about people becoming convinced that the AI tools they interact with are sentient. [主语] Dr Susan Shelmerdine └─ [同位语] a medical imaging doctor at Great Ormond Street Hospital and an AI academic[谓语] told the BBC └─ [宾语从句] that one day doctors may start asking patients └─ [宾语从句] how much they use AI（作 asking 的宾语）[方式状语] in the same way that they currently ask about smoking and drinking habits └─ that 引导方式状语从句（= in the same way as） 中文翻译：大奥蒙德街医院的医学影像科医生、同时也是 AI 学者的苏珊·谢尔默丁博士去年告诉 BBC，有朝一日医生们可能会像现在询问吸烟和饮酒习惯那样，询问病人使用 AI 的程度。 语法知识点：同位语补充说明人物身份；how much 引导宾语从句；in the same way that 表”以同样的方式”，引导方式状语从句。 背景知识补充 OpenAI：美国人工智能研究公司，总部位于旧金山，ChatGPT 的开发商，CEO 为萨姆·奥特曼（Sam Altman）。 ChatGPT：OpenAI 于 2022 年推出的对话式 AI 聊天机器人，是目前全球用户量最大的 AI 产品之一。 Study Mode（学习模式）：OpenAI 2025 年为学生推出的功能，通过引导式提问帮助用户理解知识，而非直接给出答案。 Mustafa Suleyman（穆斯塔法·苏莱曼）：微软 AI 部门负责人，人工智能公司 DeepMind 的联合创始人之一。 Anthropic：OpenAI 的竞争对手，开发 Claude 系列模型，其产品目前仅面向成年人。 Gemini（原名 Bard）：谷歌推出的 AI 聊天机器人，早期曾禁止儿童使用。 Policy Exchange：英国知名智库（think tank），常就教育、科技政策发布研究报告。 Great Ormond Street Hospital：伦敦大奥蒙德街儿童医院，英国顶尖的儿童专科医院。 eating disorder（进食障碍）：一类心理健康疾病，包括厌食症、暴食症等，常与身体形象焦虑相关。 晨读建议第一步：朗读（3 分钟） 先通读全文，标出所有加粗重点词，确保每个生词发音准确（可借助词典音标或语音工具）。 重点注意长难句 1 和 3 的停顿位置：在主句与从句交界处自然换气，保持意群完整。 第二步：跟读（5 分钟） 逐段跟读 BBC 原文音频或复读机模式，模仿母语者的连读、弱读与语调。 尤其关注引用句（如 Suleyman、Shelmerdine 的发言）的语气重音，理解”引语”在新闻中的强调作用。 每段跟读 2~3 遍，直到能流畅跟上原速。 第三步：复述（5 分钟） 合上材料，用英文口头复述文章要点：OpenAI 推出青少年版 ChatGPT 的三大安全改动（人声、休息提醒、学习模式/安静时段）。 再用 2~3 句中文向自己复述背景信息（英国监管空白、大学 AI 作弊风险、医生警告），检验是否真正理解。 复述时可刻意使用今日生词：roll out、default、bespoke、avalanche。 来源声明 原文出处：BBC News — OpenAI makes ChatGPT less ‘human’ for teens in new safety update（Zoe Kleinman, BBC Technology） 原文链接：https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/czxqz91n5n8o 抓取时间：2026-08-19 声明：本材料仅用于个人英语学习，版权归原作者与 BBC 所有。（内容由AI生成，仅供参考）

title: 英文晨读 · AI 裁员潮：Monday.com 加入 20+ 科技公司行列
content: 英文晨读 · AI 裁员潮：Monday.com 加入 20+ 科技公司行列封面信息 标题：Monday.com is the latest tech company to blame AI for layoffs — here are 20 others 作者：Rebecca Bellan, Connie Loizos 媒体：TechCrunch 发布时间：2026-08-19（持续更新，Monday.com 条目为最新更新） 原文链接：https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/25/the-running-list-major-tech-layoffs-in-2026-where-employers-cited-ai/ 预计阅读时长：15 分钟 全文摘要 总部位于特拉维夫的工作管理软件公司 Monday.com 本周宣布裁员约 20%（600 余人），并在 SEC 文件中将裁员归因于以”AI 驱动增长战略”为核心的业务重组。 联合创始人 Eran Zinman 在备忘录中强调，此举”不是为了降本或用人替代”，而是为一年前提出的 AI-first 愿景调整组织架构；公司仍预计 2026 年营收同比增长最高可达 20%。 《金融时报》最新分析显示，2026 年以来美国科技公司已裁减近 14 万个岗位，其中亚马逊、甲骨文、微软、Meta 四家合计约占 5 万，而这些公司同时在向 AI 数据中心投入数千亿美元。 FT 还发现，以 AI 为裁员理由的公司，在公告后 30 个交易日内的表现跑输纳斯达克指数近 10%，显示市场并不完全相信这套说辞。 不过局面并非全盘悲观：Anthropic、OpenAI 等 AI 原生公司在快速扩招；Meta 将约 7000 名员工转入 AI 岗位，IBM 也计划将 AI 与混合云方向的新人招聘增至三倍。 英文原文1 Monday.com, the Tel Aviv-based work management software company known for its colorful, customizable project-tracking boards, this week became the latest tech company to cite AI as a factor in job cuts. On Wednesday, the company said in an SEC filing that it will lay off about 20% of its workforce, or just over 600 employees, as part of a “restructuring plan” tied to its “ongoing transformation of its product, marketing, and go-to-market strategy” in support of “a leaner, more focused operating model” as it continues investing in its “AI-driven growth strategy.” 2 Co-founder Eran Zinman told employees in a LinkedIn memo that the move “was not made to reduce costs or replace people with AI,” positioning it instead as adapting the organization to a new AI-first vision the company laid out roughly a year ago when it rebranded around a platformwide AI push. Monday.com, which has two offices in the U.S., expects $45 million to $55 million in net restructuring charges but still projects up to 20% year-over-year revenue growth for 2026. 3 So far, according to new Financial Times analysis, U.S. tech companies have slashed nearly 140,000 jobs since the start of this year, with Amazon, Oracle, Meta, and Microsoft alone accounting for almost 50,000 of those cuts as they funnel hundreds of billions of dollars into AI data center buildouts. 4 Interestingly, the FT also found that companies citing AI as a factor in job cuts have underperformed the Nasdaq by almost 10% in the 30 trading days following their announcements, suggesting the market doesn’t entirely buy the stories that the companies are telling. 5 Still, the picture isn’t uniformly bleak. The FT notes that AI-focused companies like Anthropic and OpenAI are hiring rapidly, absorbing some of the talent shed elsewhere in the industry. And within some of the very companies making cuts, headcount is shifting rather than disappearing entirely. Meta, for instance, earlier this year moved roughly 7,000 employees into new AI-focused roles even as it laid off 8,000 others, and IBM says it’s tripling entry-level hiring for AI and hybrid-cloud roles alongside recent cuts. 6 Microsoft — July 9, 2026. Microsoft cut about 4,800 roles, or 2.1% of its global workforce, most of them in its Xbox gaming unit, resetting the business only three years after acquiring Activision Blizzard for $75 billion, per FT. Separately, it offered buyouts structured as voluntary separations, without disclosing how many employees these would impact. The company said the role eliminations were “not being replaced by AI” but acknowledged “AI is changing how work gets done.” CFO Amy Hood said total headcount declined year-over-year in fiscal Q3, and was expected to keep declining as the company focuses on “building high-performing teams that operate with pace and agility” amid rising AI investment. 生词释义表 单词 词性 中文释义 原文例句 customizable adj. 可定制的 Monday.com is known for its colorful, customizable project-tracking boards. cite v. 引用，援引（作为理由） the company said … it will lay off about 20% of its workforce … as part of a “restructuring plan” workforce n. 员工总数，劳动力 Microsoft cut about 4,800 roles, or 2.1% of its global workforce. restructuring n. 重组，结构调整 … as part of a “restructuring plan” tied to its “ongoing transformation…” transformation n. 转型，变革 … its “ongoing transformation of its product, marketing, and go-to-market strategy” rebrand v. 重塑品牌，改版定位 … when it rebranded around a platformwide AI push. slash v. 大幅削减 U.S. tech companies have slashed nearly 140,000 jobs since the start of this year. funnel v. （大量）投入、输送（资金） … as they funnel hundreds of billions of dollars into AI data center buildouts. underperform v. 表现逊于（基准指标） … have underperformed the Nasdaq by almost 10% … uniformly adv. 一律地，无例外地 Still, the picture isn’t uniformly bleak. bleak adj. 暗淡的，无望的 Still, the picture isn’t uniformly bleak. absorb v. 吸纳，吸收 … hiring rapidly, absorbing some of the talent shed elsewhere. shed v. 分流，裁减（人员） … absorbing some of the talent shed elsewhere in the industry. headcount n. 员工总数，人头数 … headcount is shifting rather than disappearing entirely. triple v. 增至三倍 IBM says it’s tripling entry-level hiring for AI and hybrid-cloud roles. buyout n. （离职）买断补偿 it offered buyouts structured as voluntary separations. 长难句解析1. On Wednesday, the company said in an SEC filing that it will lay off about 20% of its workforce, or just over 600 employees, as part of a “restructuring plan” tied to its “ongoing transformation of its product, marketing, and go-to-market strategy” in support of “a leaner, more focused operating model” as it continues investing in its “AI-driven growth strategy.” 结构拆解：主干为 the company said；that it will lay off ... 是宾语从句；or just over 600 employees 是 20% 的同位语补充；as part of a "restructuring plan" 作方式状语；tied to ... 是过去分词短语作后置定语修饰 plan；in support of ... 表目的；句末 as it continues investing ... 是原因/伴随状语从句。 中文翻译：周三，该公司在提交给美国证券交易委员会的文件中表示，作为”重组计划”的一部分，将裁减约 20% 的员工（略多于 600 人）；该计划与其”产品、营销和市场进入策略的持续转型”挂钩，旨在支持”更精简、更专注的运营模式”，同时公司继续投资于其”AI 驱动的增长战略”。 语法知识点：过去分词短语作后置定语（tied to …）；as 引导原因状语从句；同位语补充说明（or just over 600 employees）。 2. Co-founder Eran Zinman told employees in a LinkedIn memo that the move “was not made to reduce costs or replace people with AI,” positioning it instead as adapting the organization to a new AI-first vision the company laid out roughly a year ago when it rebranded around a platformwide AI push. 结构拆解：主干为 Eran Zinman told employees；that the move ... 是宾语从句；positioning it instead as adapting ... 是现在分词短语作结果/伴随状语；the company laid out roughly a year ago 是省略关系词的定语从句修饰 vision；when it rebranded ... 是时间状语从句。 中文翻译：联合创始人 Eran Zinman 在领英备忘录中告诉员工，此举”并非为了降低成本或用 AI 取代员工”，而是将此举定位为让组织适应新的 AI-first 愿景——这一愿景大约一年前公司在围绕平台级 AI 战略重塑品牌时提出。 语法知识点：现在分词短语作伴随状语；定语从句省略关系词（vision the company laid out）；position A as B 结构。 3. Interestingly, the FT also found that companies citing AI as a factor in job cuts have underperformed the Nasdaq by almost 10% in the 30 trading days following their announcements, suggesting the market doesn’t entirely buy the stories that the companies are telling. 结构拆解：主干为 the FT found；that companies ... have underperformed ... 是宾语从句；citing AI as a factor 是现在分词短语作后置定语修饰 companies；following their announcements 是现在分词短语作时间后置定语修饰 days；句末 suggesting the market doesn't ... 是现在分词短语作结果状语，其中 the market doesn't buy ... 为省略 that 的宾语从句。 中文翻译：有意思的是，《金融时报》还发现，那些以 AI 为裁员理由的公司，在发布公告后的 30 个交易日内表现落后纳斯达克指数近 10%，这表明市场并不完全相信这些公司讲述的故事。 语法知识点：现在分词短语作结果状语（suggesting …）；buy 在这里意为”相信、买账”（口语化用法）；现在分词短语作后置定语。 4. And within some of the very companies making cuts, headcount is shifting rather than disappearing entirely. 结构拆解：within some of the very companies making cuts 为介词短语作地点状语，其中 making cuts 是现在分词短语作后置定语修饰 companies；主干为 headcount is shifting；rather than disappearing entirely 是比较结构作状语，disappearing 与 shifting 平行。 中文翻译：而在一些正在裁员的公司内部，员工总数是在转移（换岗）而非彻底消失。 语法知识点：rather than 连接两个平行动名词结构，表”而不是”；the very 强调”正是那个”。 5. Microsoft cut about 4,800 roles, or 2.1% of its global workforce, most of them in its Xbox gaming unit, resetting the business only three years after acquiring Activision Blizzard for $75 billion, per FT. 结构拆解：主干为 Microsoft cut about 4,800 roles；most of them in its Xbox gaming unit 是独立主格结构（代词+介词短语）作补充说明；resetting the business ... 是现在分词短语作结果状语；after acquiring ... 是介词短语作时间状语；per FT 为”据《金融时报》”。 中文翻译：据《金融时报》报道，微软裁掉了约 4800 个职位（占其全球员工的 2.1%），其中大部分来自 Xbox 游戏部门，这是在斥资 750 亿美元收购动视暴雪仅三年后对业务的重新调整。 语法知识点：独立主格结构（most of them in …）；现在分词短语作结果状语；per 表”按照、依据”。 背景知识补充 Monday.com：总部位于以色列特拉维夫的工作管理与项目管理软件公司，以彩色可定制的项目看板著称，2021 年在纳斯达克上市。 Eran Zinman：Monday.com 联合创始人兼 CEO，曾在微软工作，2012 年与 Roy Mann 共同创立公司（前身 dapulse）。 SEC filing：美国证券交易委员会（SEC）备案文件，上市公司重大事项（如裁员、财报）通常以 8-K 等表格形式披露。 Financial Times（FT）：英国《金融时报》，全球权威财经媒体，本文多处引用其 2026 年科技裁员专项分析。 Nasdaq：纳斯达克指数，代表美国科技股整体走势，常被用作科技公司的业绩对标基准。 Anthropic / OpenAI：两家头部 AI 原生公司（Claude 与 ChatGPT 的开发商），在行业裁员潮中仍在快速扩招。 Agentforce：Salesforce 的 AI 智能体产品线，该公司称因其效率提升，客服支持岗位需求下降。 Activision Blizzard：动视暴雪，全球知名游戏发行商，微软于 2023 年以约 690 亿美元完成收购（原文按 2026 年口径称 $75 billion）。 go-to-market strategy：市场进入策略，指产品如何定价、渠道、推广并触达客户的一整套商业打法。 晨读建议第一步：朗读（5 分钟） 通读全文 1–2 遍，重点关注加粗词汇与引号内的公司官方表述；遇到长难句按意群停顿，不要逐词蹦读。 建议先听 TechCrunch 类科技新闻播报的语速（约 150 词/分钟），模仿其重音与连读。 第二步：跟读（5 分钟） 选取第 1、3、5 段进行影子跟读（shadowing），边听边跟，注意 underperform、restructuring、transform 等词的重音位置。 跟读时重点复述数字与引语（20%、140,000、$75 billion 等），训练信息捕捉能力。 第三步：复述（5 分钟） 合上原文，用 3–5 句英文复述：谁（Monday.com）做了什么（裁员 20%）、为什么（AI 重组）、行业数据（14 万岗位）、市场反应（跑输纳指 10%）、例外情况（AI 公司扩招）。 再用中文向自己或他人转述一遍”公司为什么喜欢把裁员归因于 AI”这一核心观点，检验是否真正理解。 来源声明 原文出处：TechCrunch — “Monday.com is the latest tech company to blame AI for layoffs — here are 20 others”，作者 Rebecca Bellan 与 Connie Loizos，2026-08-19 更新（原文链接见封面信息）。 抓取时间：2026-08-20 声明：本材料仅用于个人英语学习，版权归原文作者与媒体所有。（内容由AI生成，仅供参考）

title: 英文科技新闻晨读 · Robotaxi in Nevada
content: 英文科技新闻晨读 · Robotaxi in Nevada封面信息 标题：Tesla, Uber, and Waymo all get the OK to operate thousands of robotaxis in Nevada 作者：Kirsten Korosec 媒体：TechCrunch 发布时间：2026-08-21 00:23 UTC（北京时间 08:23） 原文链接：https://techcrunch.com/2026/08/20/tesla-uber-and-waymo-all-get-the-ok-to-operate-thousands-of-robotaxis-in-nevada/ 预计阅读时长：约 5 分钟（全文 400~600 词） 全文摘要内华达州交通管理局（NTA）周四一致批准了三份许可，允许特斯拉、Uber 和 Waymo 在克拉克县（拉斯维加斯所在地）运营商业 Robotaxi（自动驾驶出租车）服务，未来 12 个月内合计最多可投放 8,000 辆。其中特斯拉上限 5,000 辆、Waymo 与 Uber 各 1,000 辆，Uber 通过与现代旗下 Motional 及 Zoox 合作运营。不过特斯拉工程师坦承，一年内很难真正部署 5,000 辆，更现实的预期是 2,500 辆左右。出租车行业工会反对这一快速放量，担心运输业过度饱和与道路过度拥挤；Uber 则主张”人机混合”的渐进式方案，以便在竞争中留有余地。拉斯维加斯正成为各巨头争夺乘客的 Robotaxi 主战场，同时也将重塑当地就业结构。 英文原文① Nevada, get ready for the robotaxis. ② The Nevada Transportation Authority unanimously approved three permits Thursday that will allow Tesla, Uber, and Waymo to operate commercial robotaxi services in Clark County, home to Las Vegas. Together, these permits would deploy up to 8,000 robotaxis across the county over the next 12 months. ③ Tesla’s permit allows it to deploy up to 5,000 robotaxis, while Waymo is allowed operate up to 1,000 autonomous vehicles over the next year. Uber was also approved for 1,000 robotaxis, which it will operate through partnerships with Hyundai subsidiary Motional and Zoox. Zoox already holds an autonomous vehicle network company permit that allows it to operate 100 robotaxis. ④ Whether these companies will be able to launch that many robotaxis is an unanswered question. Testimony from Tesla representatives and the other companies suggests the answer is no. ⑤ “The 5,000 has always been a ceiling for us,” said Eric Early, Tesla’s Cybercab chief engineer, during the meeting. “I don’t think we’ll be in a position by this time next year to deploy 5,000 vehicles, and it’s not [because of] the technology. … I think we would be extremely happy and satisfied if we could get ourselves up to 2,500, maybe a bit higher than that in the next year.” ⑥ Even if these three companies roll out only half of those totals, Clark County — and Las Vegas specifically — is shaping up to be a major robotaxi battleground, with Tesla, Uber (via its autonomous vehicle partners Motional and Zoox), and Waymo all competing for the same riders. ⑦ That kind of fast, large-scale robotaxi deployment is poised to change the city — and specifically its workforce. Depending on who you ask, these companies will either deliver a whole new category of jobs designed to maintain, charge, and clean these vehicles or will wipe out an entire category of workers: human taxi and gig drivers. ⑧ Representatives from the Livery Operators Association and local taxi companies opposed the permits, arguing the approvals move too far, too fast. ⑨ “These applications raise two grave concerns,” said Kimberly Maxson-Rushton, a lawyer representing the Livery Operators Association, at the hearing. “One deals with the oversaturation of the commercial transportation industry as a whole in Nevada,” she said. “And the second one deals with the overcrowding of the roadways, and specifically the Golden Triangle.” ⑩ The Golden Triangle, an area between the airport and Las Vegas Boulevard and the surrounding area, is where most of the AV testing has occurred to date. Motional is also testing in the downtown area and in a shopping district known as Town Square. ⑪ Uber has tried to position itself as the Goldilocks option in this fight, advocating for a hybrid approach in which ride-hailing networks are made up of humans and robotaxis. The company has even lobbied for a system that would require robotaxis to operate on a ride-hailing network that also uses human drivers, a stance that puts it at odds with Waymo and doubles as a hedge against its own autonomous ambitions falling short of Tesla’s or Waymo’s. ⑫ Uber made a similar pitch during the NTA meeting, noting that a hybrid approach would allow cities to gradually integrate vehicles to meet peak demand rather than flooding the market all at once. 生词释义表 单词 词性 中文释义 原文例句 unanimously adv. 一致地，无异议地 The Nevada Transportation Authority unanimously approved three permits Thursday. deploy v. 部署，调度（资源、车辆等） These permits would deploy up to 8,000 robotaxis across the county. permit n. 许可证，执照 Tesla’s permit allows it to deploy up to 5,000 robotaxis. subsidiary n. 子公司，附属机构 Partnerships with Hyundai subsidiary Motional and Zoox. testimony n. 证词，证言 Testimony from Tesla representatives suggests the answer is no. ceiling n. 上限，天花板 The 5,000 has always been a ceiling for us. battleground n. 战场，争夺领域 Clark County is shaping up to be a major robotaxi battleground. poised adj. 蓄势待发的，准备就绪的 That kind of deployment is poised to change the city. wipe out 短语动词 消灭，彻底清除 These companies will either … or wipe out an entire category of workers. livery n. 出租车（出租马车）行业 Representatives from the Livery Operators Association opposed the permits. grave adj. 严重的，重大的 These applications raise two grave concerns. oversaturation n. 过度饱和 The oversaturation of the commercial transportation industry. hybrid adj. 混合的 Uber advocates for a hybrid approach. lobby v. 游说（议员、官员） The company has even lobbied for a system. hedge n. 对冲手段，防范措施 A stance that doubles as a hedge against its own autonomous ambitions. integrate v. 整合，融入 Allow cities to gradually integrate vehicles to meet peak demand. 长难句解析1. The Nevada Transportation Authority unanimously approved three permits Thursday that will allow Tesla, Uber, and Waymo to operate commercial robotaxi services in Clark County, home to Las Vegas. [主句] The Nevada Transportation Authority unanimously approved three permits (Thursday)[定语从句] that will allow Tesla, Uber, and Waymo to operate commercial robotaxi services (in Clark County)[同位语] home to Las Vegas 中文翻译：内华达州交通管理局周四一致批准了三份许可，允许特斯拉、Uber 和 Waymo 在克拉克县——拉斯维加斯所在地——运营商业化 Robotaxi 服务。语法知识点：定语从句 that 修饰先行词 three permits；句末 home to Las Vegas 是 Clark County 的同位语，起补充说明作用。 2. Depending on who you ask, these companies will either deliver a whole new category of jobs designed to maintain, charge, and clean these vehicles or will wipe out an entire category of workers: human taxi and gig drivers. [现在分词短语作状语] Depending on who you ask,[并列结构] will either deliver a whole new category of jobs (designed to maintain, charge, and clean these vehicles) or will wipe out an entire category of workers (: human taxi and gig drivers) 中文翻译：视你问谁而定，这些公司要么创造出一整类新岗位——负责维护、充电和清洁这些车辆，要么会消灭一整类劳动者：人类出租车司机和网约车司机。语法知识点：either … or … 连接两个并列谓语；过去分词短语 designed to … 作后置定语修饰 jobs；冒号引出同位语解释 workers。 3. The company has even lobbied for a system that would require robotaxis to operate on a ride-hailing network that also uses human drivers, a stance that puts it at odds with Waymo and doubles as a hedge against its own autonomous ambitions falling short of Tesla’s or Waymo’s. [主句] The company has even lobbied for a system[定语从句1] that would require robotaxis to operate on a ride-hailing network[定语从句2] that also uses human drivers[同位语] a stance that puts it at odds with Waymo and doubles as a hedge[介词宾语] against its own autonomous ambitions (falling short of Tesla's or Waymo's) 中文翻译：该公司甚至游说推行一种体系——要求 Robotaxi 必须在一个同样使用人类司机的网约车网络上运营，这一立场使其与 Waymo 立场相左，同时也充当了对冲手段，以防自身自动驾驶雄心不及特斯拉或 Waymo。语法知识点：多层定语从句嵌套（a system that … a network that …）；a stance that … 是整句内容的同位语；falling short of 为现在分词短语作后置定语，表示”不及、未达到”。 4. Uber made a similar pitch during the NTA meeting, noting that a hybrid approach would allow cities to gradually integrate vehicles to meet peak demand rather than flooding the market all at once. [主句] Uber made a similar pitch (during the NTA meeting)[现在分词短语作伴随状语] noting that a hybrid approach would allow cities to gradually integrate vehicles (to meet peak demand) rather than flooding the market all at once 中文翻译：Uber 在内华达州交通管理局会议上也做了类似陈述，指出混合方案能让各城市逐步投放车辆以满足高峰需求，而不是一次性让市场涌入大量车辆。语法知识点：现在分词 noting 作伴随状语，逻辑主语是 Uber；rather than 连接两个并列的动名词结构 integrate … rather than flooding …，需注意前后形式平行。 5. Whether these companies will be able to launch that many robotaxis is an unanswered question. [主语从句] Whether these companies will be able to launch that many robotaxis[系表结构] is an unanswered question 中文翻译：这些公司能否真正投放这么多 Robotaxi 仍是个未解之谜。语法知识点：Whether 引导主语从句作句子的主语，谓语用单数 is；该句为”主语从句 + 系动词 + 表语”结构。 背景知识补充 Nevada Transportation Authority（NTA）：内华达州交通管理局，负责审批和监督州内客运交通服务，本次即由其投票批准三份 Robotaxi 运营许可。 Clark County（克拉克县）：内华达州南部县，包含拉斯维加斯市，是美国最热门的自动驾驶测试与运营区域之一。 Waymo：谷歌母公司 Alphabet 旗下的自动驾驶公司，Robotaxi 商业化最成熟的企业之一。 Motional：现代汽车与安波福（Aptiv）合资成立的自动驾驶公司，专门开发 L4 级无人驾驶出租车。 Zoox：亚马逊收购的自动驾驶初创公司，主打无方向盘、车厢式双向行驶的 Robotaxi。 Cybercab：特斯拉研发的无人驾驶出租车，设计上取消方向盘与踏板，采用纯视觉方案。 Golden Triangle（黄金三角区）：拉斯维加斯机场与拉斯维加斯大道之间的区域，是当地自动驾驶测试最集中的地带。 Robotaxi：Robot + Taxi，即自动驾驶出租车，是 L4 级自动驾驶的核心商业化场景。 晨读建议本材料适合”朗读 → 跟读 → 复述”三步法练习： 朗读（Reading Aloud）：通读全文 2~3 遍，注意加粗重点词与长难句的停顿，感受新闻英语的客观、简洁风格。建议朗读时用手机录音，之后回听找发音问题。 跟读（Shadowing）：对照原文模仿地道表达，重点关注文中引语部分（如 Eric Early、Kimberly Maxson-Rushton 的发言），学习如何转述观点、引用他人原话。 复述（Retelling）：合上文本，用 3~5 句英文概述本文核心事实（谁、批准了什么、数量多少、有何争议），再用 1 分钟表达你对”Robotaxi 是否该快速大规模投放”的看法，训练输出能力。 来源声明 原文出处：TechCrunch —《Tesla, Uber, and Waymo all get the OK to operate thousands of robotaxis in Nevada》，作者 Kirsten Korosec，2026-08-21 发布 原文链接：https://techcrunch.com/2026/08/20/tesla-uber-and-waymo-all-get-the-ok-to-operate-thousands-of-robotaxis-in-nevada/ 抓取时间：2026-08-21 用途声明：本材料仅用于个人英语学习，如需转载或商用请遵循原文版权规定。（内容由AI生成，仅供参考）

title: 英文晨读 | Lawsuit demands Logitech hand tariff refunds over to customers
content: 英文晨读 | Lawsuit demands Logitech hand tariff refunds over to customers一、封面信息 标题：Lawsuit demands Logitech hand tariff refunds over to customers（副标题：Logitech increased prices by up to 25 percent last year.） 作者：Scharon Harding（Ars Technica 高级科技记者） 媒体：Ars Technica（Tech Policy 板块） 发布时间：2026-08-21 19:04 UTC 原文链接：https://arstechnica.com/tech-policy/2026/08/lawsuit-demands-logitech-hand-tariff-refunds-over-to-customers/ 预计阅读时长：15 分钟（含精读与跟读） 二、全文摘要（中文）罗技（Logitech）因未把关税退款返还给消费者，正面临一起拟议的集体诉讼。2025 年 4 月，罗技以关税为由对其约 51% 的产品组合提价，部分产品涨幅高达 25%；而 2026 年 2 月美国最高法院裁定特朗普依据《国际紧急经济权力法》（IEEPA）征收的关税非法，罗技随后已从联邦政府获得 6100 万美元退款，却未向消费者退还相应款项。原告加州建筑公司 SJK Development 与居民 Ala Awadalla 在北加州联邦地区法院提起诉讼，指控罗技”双重获利”（先以关税为名多收费，再保留政府退款），并要求法院作出宣告性判决，责令罗技将关税退款收益移交消费者。罗技并非个例：微软、任天堂、索尼等消费电子公司也因类似问题被消费者起诉；任天堂已辩称顾客”得到了所购之物”并申请强制仲裁，罗技也可能效仿这一应诉策略。 三、英文原文（English Original）1. Logitech is facing a proposed class action lawsuit for not giving customers tariff refunds. 2. In April 2025, Logitech raised the prices on 51 percent of its portfolio, with some prices increasing by as much as 25 percent. 3. The complaint seeks to “recover monies that Logitech extracted from American consumers as offset for import tariffs that the United States Supreme Court has since declared unlawful, tariffs for which Logitech now stands to be reimbursed by the federal government. This is all while Logitech retained every dollar of the corresponding price increases it charged its customers due to the illegal tariffs.” 4. A construction and residential housing builder in California, SJK Development, and California resident Ala Awadalla filed the complaint in the US District Court for the Northern District of California, San Jose Division on Tuesday. Per the complaint, both parties bought Logitech mice at higher prices. 5. “Had Logitech not inflated its prices in the name of the unlawful IEEPA [International Emergency Economic Powers Act] tariffs, Plaintiff[s] would have paid less for the same product. Plaintiff[s] has received no refund, credit, or other compensation from Logitech corresponding to the tariff component of the price Plaintiff[s] paid,” the complaint reads. 6. Logitech didn’t make a public announcement about the price hikes, which are still implemented. The complaint highlights multiple times that Logitech executives told investors that the price increases would or had offset the financial impact of the tariffs. This includes a call in May when Matteo Anversa, Logitech’s CFO, said, “The positive impact of the US price actions and favorable foreign exchange more than offset the impact of tariffs and higher promotions.” Anversa was discussing Logitech’s fiscal Q4 2026, which he noted was “the highest level of profitability in the history of the company outside of the COVID peak.” 7. In February, the Supreme Court ruled that President Donald Trump imposed the IEEPA tariffs illegally. The refund process is ongoing. 8. The complaint notes that “Logitech received a full refund of $61 million for the tariffs invalidated by the Supreme Court, including $15 million during the first quarter of fiscal year 2027 and $46 million subsequent to quarter end.” It adds: 9. … Logitech has been—and absent relief will continue to be—enriched twice over at its customers’ expense: once by the tariff-justified overcharges collected from Plaintiffs and the Class, and again by the government’s refund, with interest, of the very duties those overcharges were represented to cover. 10. The lawsuit is seeking a declaratory judgement that Logitech must give IEEPA tariff refund proceeds to customers. 11. (Tariff lawsuits) 12. Logitech joins a handful of other consumer tech companies, including Microsoft, Nintendo, and Sony, that customers are suing over tariff refunds. Some customers feel entitled to being refunded as these companies were, although mass refunds like this could present financial and logistical challenges. 13. For its part, Nintendo has argued that customers “received exactly what they paid for” and that there is not “anything ‘unjust’ about Nintendo retaining money that it may receive from the government as tariff refunds.” It also filed a motion to compel arbitration, a move that Logitech may also pursue, considering that its end-user license agreement has arbitration provisions. 14. Logitech didn’t respond to Ars Technica’s request for comment. 四、生词释义表 单词 词性 中文释义 原文例句 tariff n. 关税；（服务）价目表 Logitech is facing a proposed class action lawsuit for not giving customers tariff refunds. lawsuit n. 诉讼，官司 Logitech is facing a proposed class action lawsuit for not giving customers tariff refunds. refund n. / v. 退款；退还 Logitech is facing a proposed class action lawsuit for not giving customers tariff refunds. portfolio n. （公司）产品组合；投资组合 Logitech raised the prices on 51 percent of its portfolio. complaint n. 起诉状；投诉 The complaint seeks to recover monies that Logitech extracted from American consumers. reimburse v. 报销，退还（费用） …tariffs for which Logitech now stands to be reimbursed by the federal government. inflate v. 抬高（价格）；使膨胀 Had Logitech not inflated its prices in the name of the unlawful IEEPA tariffs… offset v. / n. 抵消，弥补 …the price increases would or had offset the financial impact of the tariffs. highlight v. 强调，突出 The complaint highlights multiple times that Logitech executives told investors… fiscal adj. 财政的，会计年度的 Anversa was discussing Logitech’s fiscal Q4 2026. invalidate v. 使无效，使作废 Logitech received a full refund of $61 million for the tariffs invalidated by the Supreme Court. declaratory adj. 宣告性的，确认性的 The lawsuit is seeking a declaratory judgement. arbitration n. 仲裁 It also filed a motion to compel arbitration. provision n. 条款，规定 …its end-user license agreement has arbitration provisions. entitle v. 使有权，使有资格 Some customers feel entitled to being refunded as these companies were. 五、长难句解析1. 原句： The complaint seeks to “recover monies that Logitech extracted from American consumers as offset for import tariffs that the United States Supreme Court has since declared unlawful, tariffs for which Logitech now stands to be reimbursed by the federal government.” 结构拆解： 主句：The complaint seeks to recover monies 定语从句①：that Logitech extracted from American consumers（修饰 monies） 目的/方式状语：as offset for import tariffs 定语从句②：that the United States Supreme Court has since declared unlawful（修饰 tariffs） 非限制性定语从句：for which Logitech now stands to be reimbursed by the federal government（继续修饰 tariffs） 中文翻译：起诉状要求追回罗技从美国消费者那里收取的钱款——这些钱被当作进口关税的抵偿，而美国最高法院后来已裁定这些关税非法；对于这些关税，罗技现在正等着联邦政府退款。 语法知识点：多个定语从句层层嵌套修饰名词；stand to do 表示”即将/有望做某事”；as offset for 为介词短语作方式状语。 2. 原句： “Had Logitech not inflated its prices in the name of the unlawful IEEPA tariffs, Plaintiff[s] would have paid less for the same product.” 结构拆解： 虚拟条件句（倒装）：Had Logitech not inflated its prices in the name of ...（= If Logitech had not inflated…） 主句：Plaintiff[s] would have paid less for the same product 中文翻译：如果罗技没有打着非法的 IEEPA 关税旗号抬高价格，原告本可以为同样的产品少付一些钱。 语法知识点：与过去事实相反的虚拟语气；条件句省略 if 后 had 提前形成倒装；in the name of 意为”以……的名义”。 3. 原句： This includes a call in May when Matteo Anversa, Logitech’s CFO, said, “The positive impact of the US price actions and favorable foreign exchange more than offset the impact of tariffs and higher promotions.” 结构拆解： 主句：This includes a call in May 定语从句：when Matteo Anversa ... said, ...（when 修饰时间名词 call，相当于 during which） 同位语：Logitech's CFO（解释 Matteo Anversa 身份） 直接引语："The positive impact ... more than offset the impact ..." 中文翻译：其中包括五月的一次电话会，罗技首席财务官 Matteo Anversa 在会上表示：”美国提价行动和有利的外汇走势带来的正面影响，远远超过了关税和更高促销成本带来的影响。” 语法知识点：when 引导定语从句修饰时间名词；同位语补充身份；more than 此处表示”远远超过”，起强调作用。 4. 原句： … Logitech has been—and absent relief will continue to be—enriched twice over at its customers’ expense: once by the tariff-justified overcharges collected from Plaintiffs and the Class, and again by the government’s refund, with interest, of the very duties those overcharges were represented to cover. 结构拆解： 主谓结构：Logitech has been enriched twice over（enriched 后接方式状语） 插入语：and absent relief will continue to be（省略 enriched，表示”若无法获得救济将继续如此”） 并列方式状语：once by the tariff-justified overcharges ... , and again by the government's refund ... 定语从句（省略关系代词）：those overcharges were represented to cover（修饰 duties） 中文翻译：罗技已经——并且在无法获得救济的情况下将继续——以牺牲客户利益为代价双重获利：一次是通过以关税为名向原告及集体成员收取的过高收费，另一次是政府退还的那笔、原本声称用以覆盖这些过高收费的关税本金（连同利息）。 语法知识点：插入语造成的结构隔断；省略（continue to be 后省略 enriched）；并列介词短语；定语从句省略关系代词。 5. 原句： For its part, Nintendo has argued that customers “received exactly what they paid for” and that there is not “anything ‘unjust’ about Nintendo retaining money that it may receive from the government as tariff refunds.” 结构拆解： 主句：Nintendo has argued 宾语从句①：that customers "received exactly what they paid for"（内含 what 引导的宾语从句） 宾语从句②：and that there is not "anything 'unjust' about Nintendo retaining money that it may receive ..." 定语从句：that it may receive from the government as tariff refunds（修饰 money） 中文翻译：就任天堂而言，它辩称顾客”得到了他们花钱购买的东西”，而且”任天堂保留它可能从政府获得的关税退款”，这其中并无任何”不公正”之处。 语法知识点：两个 that 引导的并列宾语从句；what 宾语从句；that 定语从句修饰 money；For its part 为固定短语，意为”就……而言”。 六、背景知识补充 Logitech（罗技）：瑞士-美国跨国电脑外设制造商，产品涵盖鼠标、键盘、摄像头等，是全球消费电子市场的主要玩家。 IEEPA（International Emergency Economic Powers Act）：《国际紧急经济权力法》，美国 1977 年联邦法律，授权总统在宣布国家紧急状态后管制对外经济交易；2026 年 2 月美国最高法院裁定其不能作为总统加征关税的法律依据。 class action（集体诉讼）：由一名或多名原告代表”类别”（Class）中处境相同的所有消费者提起的诉讼，法院判决对全体成员具有约束力。 US Supreme Court（美国最高法院）：美国联邦最高司法机构，其 2026 年 2 月裁决认定特朗普以 IEEPA 为名对多国商品加征的关税违法，由此引发企业关税退款如何处置的大范围法律争议。 motion to compel arbitration（强制仲裁动议）：一方请求法院强制双方按其用户协议中的仲裁条款解决争议，从而绕开集体诉讼程序，是科技公司常见的应诉策略。 Scharon Harding：Ars Technica 高级科技记者，长期报道消费电子与硬件产业动态。 七、晨读建议（朗读 → 跟读 → title: 英文晨读 · 2026-08-24 · Inherent Faraday
content: 英文晨读 · 2026-08-24 · Inherent Faraday封面信息 标题：Inherent, founded by DeepMind alumni, says its AI ‘teammate’ just outperformed Anthropic and OpenAI at replicating research 作者：Anna Heim 来源：TechCrunch 发布时间：2026-08-22 19:00 UTC（北京时间 2026-08-23 03:00） 原文链接：https://techcrunch.com/2026/08/22/inherent-founded-by-deepmind-alumni-says-its-ai-teammate-just-outperformed-anthropic-and-openai-at-replicating-research/ 预计阅读时长：约 15 分钟 全文摘要伦敦 AI 实验室 Inherent 由谷歌 DeepMind 校友创立，其新发布的 AI 智能体 Faraday 在”独立复现已发表科学论文结论”的任务上，击败了 Anthropic 的 Claude Opus 4.8 和 OpenAI 的 GPT-5.5 两个规模大得多的前沿模型。Faraday 的底层模型仅为 270 亿参数的 Qwen 3.6，且不自行编写代码，而是调用 OpenAI 的 GPT-5.5 Codex 完成编程工作。Inherent 将成功归因于强化学习训练方式——奖励系统产出好结果，而非灌输固定规则，目标是培养 AI 的”研究品味”。公司联合创始人兼首席科学家 Edward Hughes 表示，最终愿景是打造能发现新科学知识的 AI 科学家智能体，而论文复现只是起点。Inherent 目前十余人在伦敦国王十字办公，计划年底扩至 20-25 人，并呼吁废除英国限制人才流动的”花园假期”制度。 英文原文1. Inherent, a London AI lab founded by Google DeepMind alumni, says its AI agent just outperformed much larger models from Anthropic and OpenAI using a fraction of the size. 2. Of all the startups launched by Google DeepMind alumni, Inherent has gotten relatively little attention. But while better-funded rivals have yet to show the world anything concrete, the London-based team is starting to share what it’s been building. 3. Just weeks after emerging from stealth with a $50 million seed round, the British startup says its newly released AI agent, Faraday, has outperformed larger, better-known models at a specific task: independently reproducing the findings of published scientific papers without being told the answer in advance. 4. That may sound like a mere party trick given Inherent’s much loftier goal — building AI that can discover new scientific knowledge and not just verify old results. But paper replication is a standard training exercise for human scientists, too, cofounder and chief scientist Edward Hughes said. “Many PhD students actually start by doing this.” 5. Beating other AI systems at the task wasn’t the point, Hughes told TechCrunch; how they got there was. “What was most interesting to us about this was not so much the result of beating those frontier agents — which of course we liked — but was actually the way we went about building this.” 6. Here’s the part that should catch an investor’s eye: measured against Anthropic’s Claude Opus 4.8 and OpenAI’s GPT-5.5 — both much larger, frontier-scale systems — Faraday runs on a comparatively tiny model called Qwen 3.6 that has just 27 billion parameters. (Roughly speaking, “parameters” is a proxy for a model’s size and, typically, its training costs, as well.) Inherent’s bar for success was also higher than simply accuracy. Beyond replicating results, it wanted Faraday to demonstrate “research taste” — an instinct for what experiments are worth running and how to design them well. 7. Teaching something as intangible as taste is hard, which is where reinforcement learning comes in. It’s a training method that rewards an AI system for good outcomes rather than spelling out rules for it to follow. Rather than training its agents primarily on the study of how science itself is conducted, Inherent leans on this reward-based approach, betting it will generalize better to its longer-term goal of agents capable of contributing across many scientific fields. 8. “We’re always guided by that north star of building an AI scientist agent and imbuing our agents with taste,” Hughes said. That focus has also shaped what Inherent chooses not to build. Rather than developing its own coding tool, it had Faraday use OpenAI’s GPT-5.5 Codex instead, much the way human scientists lean on existing software rather than building everything themselves, according to the company. 9. Inherent is also trying to avoid building agents that simply tell users what they want to hear. Instead, Hughes said, the goal is modeled on his favorite kind of teammate — the kind who comes back and says: “I got curious about this, and I went off and I did these experiments. What do you think of these results?” 生词释义表 单词 词性 中文释义 原文例句 outperform v. 胜过，超越 its AI agent just outperformed much larger models from Anthropic and OpenAI stealth n. 隐身，秘密状态 Just weeks after emerging from stealth with a $50 million seed round lofty adj. 崇高的，远大的 Inherent’s much loftier goal — building AI that can discover new scientific knowledge replication n. 复现，复制 paper replication is a standard training exercise for human scientists frontier adj. 前沿的 not so much the result of beating those frontier agents parameter n. 参数（衡量模型规模的指标） Faraday runs on a comparatively tiny model called Qwen 3.6 that has just 27 billion parameters proxy n. 代理，代表指标 “parameters” is a proxy for a model’s size and, typically, its training costs intangible adj. 无形的，难以捉摸的 Teaching something as intangible as taste is hard generalize v. 泛化，推广 betting it will generalize better to its longer-term goal imbue v. 灌输，使充满 building an AI scientist agent and imbuing our agents with taste bullish adj. 看涨的，乐观的 Hughes is bullish on London’s density of AI talent barring prep. 禁止，阻拦（此处为”限制”） barring departing employees from joining or starting a rival company constraint n. 约束，限制 Hughes eventually got around that constraint headcount n. 员工人数 It plans to grow its headcount to “about 20 to 25” unsettled adj. 不安的，未定的 leaving some DeepMind staff unsettled 长难句解析1. 原句：Just weeks after emerging from stealth with a $50 million seed round, the British startup says its newly released AI agent, Faraday, has outperformed larger, better-known models at a specific task: independently reproducing the findings of published scientific papers without being told the answer in advance. 结构拆解： 时间状语：Just weeks after emerging from stealth with a $50 million seed round 主句主语：the British startup 主句谓语：says 宾语从句：its newly released AI agent, Faraday, has outperformed larger, better-known models at a specific task 冒号后解释同位语：independently reproducing the findings of published scientific papers without being told the answer in advance 中文翻译：在带着 5000 万美元种子轮融资走出隐身模式仅几周后，这家英国初创公司表示，其新发布的 AI 智能体 Faraday 在一项具体任务上超越了规模更大、知名度更高的模型：在事先不被告知答案的情况下，独立复现已发表科学论文的研究结论。 语法知识点：现在分词短语作伴随/补充说明；without being told 为介词 + 动名词被动式，表”未被告知”。 2. 原句：Here’s the part that should catch an investor’s eye: measured against Anthropic’s Claude Opus 4.8 and OpenAI’s GPT-5.5 — both much larger, frontier-scale systems — Faraday runs on a comparatively tiny model called Qwen 3.6 that has just 27 billion parameters. 结构拆解： 主句：Here's the part 定语从句修饰 the part：that should catch an investor's eye 过去分词短语作条件/背景状语：measured against ... systems 破折号插入语补充说明：both much larger, frontier-scale systems 主句核心：Faraday runs on a comparatively tiny model 定语从句修饰 model：that has just 27 billion parameters 中文翻译：下面是会让投资者眼前一亮的重点：在与 Anthropic 的 Claude Opus 4.8 和 OpenAI 的 GPT-5.5——两者都是规模大得多的前沿系统——对比时，Faraday 运行的却是一个相对很小的模型，名为 Qwen 3.6，只有 270 亿参数。 语法知识点：measured against... 为过去分词短语作状语，逻辑主语是 Faraday（被比较）；破折号间的插入语用于补充说明，翻译时可前置。 3. 原句：Rather than training its agents primarily on the study of how science itself is conducted, Inherent leans on this reward-based approach, betting it will generalize better to its longer-term goal of agents capable of contributing across many scientific fields. 结构拆解： 让步/对比状语：Rather than training its agents primarily on the study of how science itself is conducted 主句：Inherent leans on this reward-based approach 现在分词短语作结果状语：betting it will generalize better to its longer-term goal 后置定语修饰 goal：of agents capable of contributing across many scientific fields 中文翻译：Inherent 并非主要基于”科学研究本身如何进行”来训练其智能体，而是依赖这种基于奖励的方法，押注它能够更好地泛化到其长期目标——让智能体能够在多个科学领域做出贡献。 语法知识点：Rather than + 动名词 表”而不是”；betting 引导伴随结果状语；形容词短语 capable of... 作后置定语。 4. 原句：It’s a restriction American researchers generally don’t face, giving U.S. startups a head start on hiring talent who’ve left a prior role. 结构拆解： 主句：It's a restriction 省略 that 的定语从句修饰 restriction：(that) American researchers generally don't face 现在分词短语作结果状语：giving U.S. startups a head start on hiring talent 定语从句修饰 talent：who've left a prior role 中文翻译：这是一种美国研究人员通常不会面临的限制，它让美国初创公司在招聘离职人才方面占得先机。 语法知识点：定语从句中关系代词作宾语可省略；give sb. a head start 为固定搭配，表”让某人占先机/领先一步”。 5. 原句：Given its ambitions in world models as well, and with Demis Hassabis’s new role leaving some DeepMind staff unsettled, Inherent’s hiring push could make it an appealing landing spot for DeepMind employees weighing a move. 结构拆解： 原因状语（过去分词）：Given its ambitions in world models as well 独立主格结构（with + 宾语 + 宾补）：with Demis Hassabis's new role leaving some DeepMind staff unsettled 主句：Inherent's hiring push could make it an appealing landing spot 目的/对象状语：for DeepMind employees weighing a move（weighing 为现在分词作后置定语） 中文翻译：考虑到它在世界模型方面的雄心，加之 Demis Hassabis 的新职务让部分 DeepMind 员工心生不安，Inherent 的招聘计划可能使其成为考虑跳槽的 DeepMind 员工颇具吸引力的落脚点。 语法知识点：Given 作介词表”鉴于、考虑到”；with + n. + 现在分词/过去分词 构成独立主格结构作原因状语；weighing a move 中 weigh 意为”权衡、斟酌”。 背景知识补充 Inherent：伦敦 AI 实验室，由谷歌 DeepMind 校友（Edward Hughes、Louis Kirsch、Kaloyan Aleksiev、Tantum Collins）于 2026 年创立，5 月以 5000 万美元种子轮融资（Index Ventures 领投）走出隐身模式，目标是构建能自主发现新科学知识的 AI。 Faraday：Inherent 发布的 AI 智能体，底层为阿里开源模型 Qwen 3.6（270 亿参数），用强化学习训练，擅长复现科研论文结论。 论文复现（paper replication）：科研界验证已有成果能否被独立重复的流程；”可复现性危机”长期以来是科学界的痛点，Faraday 被视为首台面向该问题的”机器劳动力”。 Qwen 3.6：阿里巴巴开源的大语言模型系列，本次被海外团队用于前沿科研场景，是开源模型生态的重要信号。 Claude Opus 4.8 / GPT-5.5：Anthropic 与 OpenAI 各自的前沿大模型，规模远大于 Qwen 3.6。 强化学习（reinforcement learning）：通过奖励信号引导模型行为的训练方法，而非显式给出规则。 garden leave（花园假期）：英国常见竞业限制惯例，员工离职后数月内不得加入或创立竞争公司，被批评阻碍人才流动。 King’s Cross（国王十字）：伦敦街区，因谷歌 DeepMind 入驻而成为全球顶级 AI 研究聚集地之一。 晨读建议 朗读（3 分钟）：先通读全文 1-2 遍，出声朗读，标注生词与难句；注意第 4、5、8、9 段中直接引语的语气与重音。 跟读（6 分钟）：分段跟读（可配合原文的 AI 朗读或词典发音），重点模仿引语部分（如 Hughes 的两段直接引语）的节奏与停顿；边读边记忆生词在句中的用法。 复述（6 分钟）：合上材料，用 3-5 句英文向自己复述新闻要点（谁 / 做了什么 / 为什么重要）；随后对照第 1-9 段检查遗漏，再用中文总结”小模型如何赢大模型”的逻辑链。 来源声明 原文出处：TechCrunch，《Inherent, founded by DeepMind alumni, says its AI ‘teammate’ just outperformed Anthropic and OpenAI at replicating research》，作者 Anna Heim，2026-08-22 发布。
